messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the admit-gateway refactor meeting. Proposal: move to a compact "unified-capability" descriptor that lives with the model artifact and drives both fast smoke checks and downstream runtime decisions. Thoughts?

jon: Sounds good. Want to confirm: this descriptor is for capability discovery only, not routing policy. Router should still consult cost/region/tier policies.

mira: yes, separation of concerns. descriptor = capabilities + small telemetry hints. router = policy.

sam: what fields are non-negotiable for smoke to be deterministic and fast? we need tokenizer id, tokenizer-checksum, binary-hash, dtype, kv-enabled, and a tiny p50/p90 seqlen.

claudia: agree. add 'canonical-prefixes' (short list) so smoke can run a few canonical prompts rather than a large eval set. keeps smoke <2s.

jon: I want an explicit 'immutability' flag for artifacts. If binary-hash is mutable (rare), we fail-fast. Otherwise caches can be long lived.

zach: ops note: make sure descriptor small (<4KB) and easily indexable. we'll need to query millions of descriptors for health scans.

mira: good call. we'll enforce size limit in lint. also store descriptors as JSON blobs in model-registry with an indexed token-checksum + binary-hash.

sam: about token-checksum: propose we use sha256 of tokenizer-normalized sample set (not the tokenizer binary) so we catch behavior drift even if tokenizer code is same.

jon: implement as: take N golden utterances, run current tokenizer -> concat tokens -> sha256. keep N small (50) but diverse. store as hex string.

claudia: regarding compatibility checks: two-phase approach: 1) admit-smoke (sync): run canonical prefixes, verify token-checksum + prefix-outputs match expected tokenization and start-of-seq behaviors. 2) admit-deep (async): run full golden-eval suite, perf benches, kernel-compat sims.

mira: SLAs: admit-smoke must finish <2s with 95th percentile; admit-deep can be queued (quota based) and delivered within 24h for most models.

zach: fallback policy: if smoke fails but binary-hash matches previously approved model, allow 'canary-with-warnings' for 48h and require deep-run asap. If binary-hash differs -> block.

sam: caching: key admit-smoke cache by (token-checksum, binary-hash, descriptor-version). That avoids re-compute on churn.

jon: schema evolution: descriptor must include 'schema_version' and be additive. add a 'deprecated_fields' array for migration hints. Keep runtime tolerant of unknown fields.

claudia: bench/validator integration: bench reads the descriptor and, if sample artifact pointer present, will fetch sample-seqs (signed url) and run batch-sim in bench-worker. sample-seqs must be <= 10MB.

mira: action plan:
- mira: write canonical schema v0.1 and publish to model-registry docs by Tue 2026-03-31 (6543280000)
- jon: implement tokenizer-checksum lib + endpoint in tokenizer-service (PR by next week)
- sam: add lint rule into intake that enforces size + required fields and auto-fills defaults where safe
- claudia: produce smoke/deep definition doc with canonical prefixes and sample set (draft by Fri)
- zach: confirm index plan in registry and capacity for scanning descriptors weekly

jon: example compact descriptor sketch (inline):
```
model_id: hf/foo-1
schema_version: "0.1"
tokenizer_checksum: "sha256:deadbeef..."
binary_hash: "sha256:fea7..."
dtype: "fp16"
kv_enabled: true
seqlen: p50=32,p90=256
canonical_prefixes: ["hi","Summarize:"]
sample_seqs_artifact: s3://registry/samples/foo-2026-03-01.tar.gz
immutability: true
compat_hints: ["nonstandard-eos"]
```

sam: keep lint friendly: prefer snake_case keys and short arrays. also require contact-owner email field for ambiguous fails.

mira: final notes: avoid embedding hardware mappings in descriptor (let runtime decide). and we will version descriptor in the registry so downstream services can opt-in to v0.1 semantics.

claudia: :thumbsup: agree on canary-with-warnings and strict block on new binary-hash.

ops-bot: task created: ADMIT-GW-210 (owner: sam) | due: 2026-04-08

zach: scheduling note: expect a 2-week migration window where intake writes both legacy and unified descriptors. we'll coordinate with release team.

mira: thanks everyone. i'll drop the v0.1 YAML in the eng-ml-docs channel once drafted and tag reviewers.

jon: will start on tokenizer lib today.

sam: will open lint PR tomorrow.

mira: closing thread, will follow up with PR links.
